name: barbell banded romanian deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift with a band adding resistance as you stand. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand on the band with it attached to the barbell and hold the bar at your thighs.
Push your hips back with soft knees.
Lower the bar along your legs to mid shin.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
